programme.desc: Bobi (Kristo Immanuel), seorang kru asisten lighting yang baru sembuh dari sakit mengikuti syuting terakhir sebuah film horor. Di tempat syuting, sudah diberi arahan di hari sebelumnya bahwa lokasinya cukup angker. Terdapat larangan tidak boleh teriak, jika dilanggar maka yg melanggar akan diganggu oleh penunggu lokasi tersebut.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E3
programme.desc: Pak Terry seorang manager yang sedang lembur, ketika melewati jam 9 malam ia mengalami beberapa gangguan, mulai dari suara pintu terbuka, bunyi mesin absen, suara orang mencuci di pantry sampai komputer yang menyala sendiri. Seolah ada karyawan masuk shift kedua tapi kasat mata.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E4
programme.desc: Rey (Ge Pamungkas), anak tunggal berumur 22 tahun, adalah mahasiswa fakultas hukum dan tinggal di rumah yang besar bersama dengan keluarganya. Rey yang tinggal di rumah sendirian merasa takut sampe akhirnya menyalakan semua lampu dan mengajak teman-temannya Iqbal, Ebet dan Dewi untuk datang ke rumahnya. Sebuah kejadian horor dialami Rey ketika membuat kopi di dapur.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E5
programme.desc: Sepasang kekasih bernama Jorge (Yudha Keling) dan Zahra (Pamela Bowie) yang baru pacaran dan masih lugu ingin camping bersama di luar kota, saat mau pergi orang tua Zahra berpesan agar jangan berduaan aja, pamali. Mereka mengaku kalau perginya bersama teman-teman, namun ternyata mereka berdua saja.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E6
programme.desc: Freddy (Martin Anugrah) memutuskan untuk staycation di sebuah hotel mewah di malam Halloween dan berencana tidur tenang, tetapi diperingatkan oleh seorang receptionist (Tommy Lim) bahwa malam ini adalah malam Halloween dimana hantu hantu-hantu akan keluar bergentayangan. Freddy menolak ikut serta di Halloween Party yang ditawarkan oleh Sony dan memilih tidur di kamar.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E7
programme.desc: Karina (Sitha Marino) dan teman-teman nya bernama Aryo, Fajar, dan Yola, tidak percaya terhadap Covid. Mereka selalu menganggap Covid ini akal-akalan, hasil konspirasi untuk orang yang berkepentingan. Mereka berempat akhirnya pergi liburan ke sebuah villa di luar kota karena malas di Jakarta sedang ada PSBB. Mereka berempat mulai mengalami kejadian-kejadian yang aneh.

programme.title: Twisted S1 E8

programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 16
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 7
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian adalah seorang selir Kaisar Tang yang berusia 14 tahun nan cantik dan berbakat. Ia menjadi biarawati usai sang kaisar meninggal, tapi ia memiliki dua putra dengan Kaisar Tang Gao Zong.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Dalam drama peraih berbagai penghargaan arahan Li Han Hsiang ini, Betty Loh Ti berperan sebagai gadis cantik yang menyamar sebagai anak lelaki demi mendapatkan pendidikan yang terlarang bagi anak perempuan.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: Sebuah film yang berkisah tentang sebuah hubungan cinta nan rumit antara sekelompok anak muda yang terjerat dalam ikatan cinta dan emosi.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Kaisar tergila-gila pada Yang Gui Fei, selir kesayangannya, sehingga ia menyerahkan pemerintahan negara kepada Perdana Menteri. Namun, Perdana Menteri yang korup, membuat rakyat memberontak.

programme.title: Descendant Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang bayi matahari ajaib dikirim ke bumi oleh seorang dewa dan dibesarkan oleh seorang tukang kayu tua. Ia memiliki kemampuan bela diri nan luar biasa, yang akan lenyap akibat 'kripton hijau' saat gerhana matahari.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Li Ching aktris terbaik di era nya berperan sebagai Ah Chiao adalah seorang gadis dari desa yang tersesat di kota, yang berteman dengan seorang pemondok yang baik hati dan seorang mantan aktor.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions Of A...
programme.desc: Seorang gadis miskin yang dijual ke prostitusi segera menjadi fokus penyelidikan seorang detektif ketika serangkaian pembunuhan terjadi di rumah bordil tempat dia bekerja.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Nona Qiao meninggal secara tak wajar dan kepala pelayannya membayar seorang perajin untuk membuat sebuah boneka kertas. Serangkaian peristiwa nan mengerikan terjadi saat arwah Nona Qiao bangkit untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: Dunia berada dalam kekacauan setelah pohon kehidupan dibakar. Sun Wu Kong pun memutuskan untuk kembali ke masa lalu guna menghidupkannya kembali, tetapi kekuatannya tak stabil usai dirinya kehilangan ikat kepala emas.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang berdedikasi dihantui rasa bersalah karena telah menyelamatkan nyawa seorang pemimpin geng. Ia kemudian terobsesi untuk menghancurkan sindikat kejahatan yang dipimpin oleh pria yang pernah diselamatkannya.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Seorang fotografer terjerat oleh sesosok 'wanita berbaju merah' hingga menyebabkan kerabatnya tewas satu per satu. Ia pun bersumpah untuk mencari tahu kebenarannya saat gadis yang ia sukai juga tewas secara misterius.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Seorang fotografer terjerat oleh sesosok 'wanita berbaju merah' hingga menyebabkan kerabatnya tewas satu per satu. Ia pun bersumpah untuk mencari tahu kebenarannya saat gadis yang ia sukai juga tewas secara misterius.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming menyusupi kepolisian atas suruhan triad, sementara Yan adalah polisi yang menyamar sebagai anggota triad. Menjalani kehidupan ganda membuat keduanya merasa terjebak dalam kebohongan dan ingin mencari jalan keluar.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang pemarah dan suka main perempuan ditembak di kepala saat memburu seorang pengedar narkoba. Selama proses pemulihan, ia merenungkan kembali hidupnya dan berusaha memperbaiki pernikahannya yang hancur.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Raja Kera bereinkarnasi dalam wujud bukan manusia sebagai Joker, seorang perampok jalanan yang tidak menyadari identitas aslinya dan fakta bahwa 500 tahun sebelumnya, dia dan tuannya, Biksu Panjang Umur, dihukum dan dipaksa untuk tetap menjadi manusia.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song mengetahui perselingkuhan adik iparnya dengan pria kaya bernama Ximen Qing. Song pun dijebak dan diasingkan selama setahun oleh Qing, sementara sang adik dibunuh. Bisakah ia membalas kematian saudaranya?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Sahabat baik Bodil dan Isabel, yang tampaknya telah menikah dengan bahagia, menyelinap pergi untuk melakukan perselingkuhan rahasia dengan menggunakan satu sama lain sebagai alibi. Namun, ketika Isabel terbunuh saat mereka seharusnya bersama. Bodil terjebak dalam jaringan kebohongannya sendiri.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Seorang model (Joey Wong) diperkosa oleh seorang fotografer (Wilson Lam). Sementara itu, ia berselisih dengan sahabatnya (Carol Cheng) karena pacarnya (Alex Man), seorang polisi.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell

programme.title: Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: David Ginola : PL Moments
programme.desc: Premier League Moments sits down with one of the most stylish players ever to grace the English top flight. David Ginola lit up the league with his flair, elegance, and unforgettable goals for Newcastle United, Tottenham Hotspur, Aston Villa, and Everton. In this episode, he reflects on the moments that defined his Premier League career, from dazzling solo runs to spectacular strikes, that made him a true fan favourite.

programme.title: Pochettino'S Spurs : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: Cewek Keker Berhati Flower
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang kehidupan seorang pria muda yang tampan bernama Farel (Aliando Syarief). Farel awalnya memiliki seorang kekasih bernama Laura, tapi karena Farel tak kunjung berikan kepastian akan menikahi Laura, lalu Laura dinikahkan dengan Bima.Akibat hal itu, Laura yang sebenarnya masih menyukai Farel, bertekad untuk melampiaskan kekesalannya kepada Farel. Pada suatu hari, Laura mengajak Farel untuk naik mobil bersamanya. Di dalam mobil Laura mengungkapkan kekesalannya kepada Farel. Di sisi lain, ada seorang pedagang nasi goreng bernama Fajar yang sedang melakukan panggilan video dengan tunangannya yang diperankan oleh Baiti Syaghaf. Laura pun mengemudikan mobilnya dengan kecepatan tinggi hingga ia hampir menabrak dua orang anak kecil. Laura bermaksud untuk membanting setir, tapi ia malah menabrak gerobak nasi goreng bernama Fajar hingga akhirnya Fajar dilarikan ke sebuah klinik.

programme.title: The Canyons

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs

programme.title: The Super

programme.title: Armored

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Bring Your Daughter
programme.desc: Kehadiran seorang tamu cilik di Woodstone Manor membawa dinamika baru bagi Sam dan Jay, yang harus menyeimbangkan urusan keluarga dengan tingkah laku para penghuni arwah. Seperti biasa, para hantu tidak tinggal diam dan justru ikut campur dengan cara-cara yang mengundang tawa sekaligus menimbulkan berbagai kesalahpahaman. Di balik kekacauan tersebut, hubungan antarkarakter berkembang melalui momen-momen yang hangat dan menyentuh. Episode "Bring Your Daughter" menghadirkan perpaduan komedi supranatural dan kisah keluarga yang penuh pesona.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Sunny Girl
programme.desc: Sunny Girl

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: New Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: New Keluarga Somat

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.desc: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO MOVIE: SNOW FAIRY ADVENTURE)
programme.desc: PORORO DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA MELAKUKAN PERJALANAN AJAIB KE DESA PERI SALJU UNTUK MENYELAMATKAN MUSIM DINGIN SETELAH SEBUAH INSIDEN MEMBAHAYAKAN SALJU ABADI. BERSAMA DENGAN PERI SALJU, MEREKA HARUS MENGHADAPI PETUALANGAN MENDEBARKAN UNTUK MENGEMBALIKAN KEAJAIBAN MUSIM DINGIN SEBELUM SEMUANYA TERLAMBAT.

programme.title: Pokemon Xyz
programme.desc: Pokemon Xyz

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 23: THE JOURNEYS
programme.desc: POKEMON JOURNEYS ADALAH SERI ANIME POKEMON YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN SEORANG PELATIH POKEMON BERNAMA ASH KETCHUM DAN TEMANNYA, GOH. MEREKA MELAKUKAN PERJALANAN MELINTASI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON UNTUK MENGEJAR IMPIAN MEREKA. DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI POKEMON LEGENDARIS, BERTARUNG MELAWAN PELATIH HANDAL, DAN BELAJAR BANYAK HAL BARU TENTANG POKEMON. CERITANYA BERFOKUS PADA PERTEMANAN, PETUALANGAN, DAN PERKEMBANGAN KARAKTER YANG DIBAWA OLEH PERJALANAN MEREKA DI DUNIA POKEMON.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Saksikan keseruan momo, cici, blu dan geng. menemani tumbuh kembangmu, generasi emas indonesia untuk dunia!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. MEREKA MEMPERBAIKI MASALAH TEKNOLOGI SEHARI-HARI SAMBIL MENGAJARKAN PENONTON TENTANG SAINS DAN TEKNOLOGI SECARA MENYENANGKAN. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.desc: Film televisi yang mengangkat kisah romantisme kehidupan dengan konflik yang menarik.

programme.title: Asmara Gen Z New Era
programme.desc: Sinetron yang bercerita tentang persahabatan, cinta dan serunya keseharian para Gen Z. Dibintangi oleh AQEELA CALISTA, FATTAH SYACH, ARYA MOHAN, NICOLE ROSSI, HARRY VAUGHAN dan RAISA MARIE. Tayang setiap hari pukul 17.00 WIB.

programme.title: Asmara Gen Z New Era
programme.desc: Kisah para Gen Z berlanjut saat Mohan, Aqeela, Harry, dan teman-temannya memasuki babak baru kehidupan di bangku kuliah. Di tengah dunia kampus yang penuh warna, mereka dipertemukan dengan Salvatore, Gizelle, Gavin, Cantika, Savanna, dan Renzo, yang membawa warna baru dalam persahabatan, cinta, dan ambisi mereka.

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja
programme.desc: Kanaya (Sandrinna Michelle) seorang gadis remaja yang populer di sekolah, namun di rumah ia hanyalah seorang kakak yang harus menjaga adiknya, Alisa (Giselle Irene), apalagi Alisa yang memutuskan untuk sekolah bersama Kanaya. Tidak hanya itu, di sekolah Kanaya harus berhadapan dengan cinta pertamanya Arga (Andy William) dan Dastan (Lazuardy Nasution), anak baru yang tengil di sekolah. Bagaimanakah nasib Kanaya selanjutnya? Sakiskan SINETRON TERBARU SEINDAH MASA REMAJA

programme.title: Seindah Masa Remaja
programme.desc: Kanaya menjalani masa SMA yang penuh warna sebagai kapten tim dance populer, hingga kedatangan adiknya, Alisa, mengubah segalanya. Di tengah persahabatan, cinta pertama, persaingan, dan rahasia yang harus disembunyikan, keduanya menghadapi perjalanan remaja yang menguji arti keluarga, mimpi, dan cinta.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia arina (febby rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama reno (randy jhon) dihancurkan oleh fico (rangga azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron terbaru biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: Vidio Original Series Love Is A Story
Vidio Original: Love Is A Story
programme.desc: Tristan dan Damar, dua orang yang telah bersahabat sejak lama ternyata jatuh cinta pada perempuan yang sama. Suatu ketika, kejadian yang tak disangka merubah hidup mereka.

programme.title: OB Cantik Jadi Sekretaris...
programme.desc: Menceritakan seorang OB bernama Iren (Amanda Rawles) yang harus bergegas bekerja karena telat akibat melamun menjadi seorang bos,namun saat menuju ke kantornya dia bertemu dengan bos (Dimas Anggara) tempat dia bekerja.

programme.desc: Tonton kumpulan Film Televisi andalan SCTV

programme.title: Sinema Dini Hari
programme.desc: Sinema Dini Hari menayangkan beragam film dari berbagai genre baik dari Indonesia maupun global.

programme.title: Barakallah
programme.desc: Setiap episode dihadirkan bersama pembawa acara dan bintang tamu yang berbagi kisah, pengalaman, dan solusi berdasarkan ajaran Islam mulai dari masalah rumah tangga, persahabatan, hingga tantangan sosial modern.

programme.title: Buser
programme.desc: Buser adalah program berita kriminal yang menyoroti berbagai kasus kejahatan yang terjadi di Indonesia.

programme.title: Liputan 6 Pagi (L)
programme.desc: Disiarkan setiap pagi, program ini menyajikan berita nasional, ekonomi, sosial, kriminal, serta inspirasi positif untuk memulai hari.

programme.title: Halo Selebriti
programme.desc: Acara ini menampilkan kabar seputar kehidupan selebriti, mulai dari aktivitas, prestasi, hingga gosip terkini yang sedang menjadi sorotan publik.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Eaux Turbulentes
programme.desc: Helene Florent, Gabriel Sabourin, Jacob Whiteduck-Lavoie, Charles Bender

programme.title: EAUX TURBULENTES
programme.desc: Eaux Turbulentes mengisahkan Marianne Desbiens, seorang penyelidik kepolisian yang terpaksa kembali ke kampung halamannya setelah mengalami masalah dalam kariernya. Sesampainya di Queensbury, ia menerima tugas untuk menyelidiki kematian misterius seorang perempuan muda dari komunitas adat. Seiring penyelidikan berlangsung, Marianne menemukan bahwa kasus tersebut berkaitan dengan berbagai rahasia yang telah lama terkubur, baik dalam masyarakat setempat maupun dalam kehidupannya sendiri. Di tengah upaya mengungkap kebenaran, ia harus menghadapi konflik keluarga, luka masa lalu, dan ketegangan sosial yang membelah komunitas. Serial ini memadukan unsur misteri kriminal dengan drama emosional yang kuat, menghadirkan kisah tentang keadilan, identitas, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: La Faune Connectee
programme.desc: Each winter, Northern map turtles hibernate under the ice on Opinicon Lake, with no access to air. In the face of climate warming and sound pollution, they have become essential allies for biologists, helped by recent technologies to study how they adapt.

The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: L'Afrik En Contes
programme.desc: Wara the lion is a scornful king who has a very high opinion of himself. One day, he decides to cut down the tree that produces all the fruit that feeds the village, to make a throne for himself. But a genie is hiding in the tree's branches.

programme.title: L'AFRIK EN CONTES
programme.desc: L'AFRIK EN CONTES menghidupkan kembali dongeng tradisional Afrika melalui animasi penuh warna dan penceritaan yang menarik. Setiap episode menyampaikan pesan moral, humor, dan warisan budaya, memperkenalkan penonton muda pada tokoh-tokoh legendaris serta kebijaksanaan turun-temurun.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: API !
programme.desc: Api ! mengisahkan keseharian Api, seorang siswi cerdas dan bertanggung jawab, bersama teman-temannya di lingkungan sekolah dasar. Setiap episode menghadirkan cerita tentang persahabatan, tantangan belajar, konflik kecil, hingga petualangan yang membantu mereka tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih baik. Melalui berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan kehidupan anak-anak, serial ini mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti kejujuran, rasa tanggung jawab, empati, dan kerja sama. Dengan pendekatan yang ringan dan menghibur, Api ! menjadi tontonan edukatif yang membantu anak-anak memahami dunia sosial di sekitar mereka.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boite !
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. Dengan perpaduan fantasi, humor, dan aksi yang ringan, serial animasi ini menghadirkan pengalaman yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif bagi anak-anak.

Melalui kisah pribadi warga dari berbagai wilayah, generasi, dan latar belakang budaya, film ini memperlihatkan bagaimana tradisi, bahasa, sejarah, dan pengalaman hidup bersama membentuk wajah Swiss masa kini. programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: My Daughter Is A Zombie
programme.desc: One year after an unprecedented zombie attack that killed hundreds of thousands, South Korea has finally been declared zombie-free. But Jeonghwan holds a secret: his daughter is the last zombie left on earth.

programme.title: Pretty Crazy
programme.desc: Seorang calon koki kue hidup tanpa menyadari bahwa setiap malam ia berubah menjadi iblis betina yang liar. Keluarganya menyewa tetangga mereka untuk mengawasi wujud malamnya, sementara si tetangga jatuh cinta pada wujud siangnya dan berusaha mematahkan kutukannya.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent Jun
programme.desc: Ketika berada di bawah pengaruh alkohol, seorang komikus gagal menggambar komik tentang kisah hidupnya sebagai mantan pembunuh bayaran NIS, dan ia mendapatkan masalah saat komik tersebut diterbitkan online.

programme.title: Okay! Madam (tvN Movies)

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: If... Dog... Rabbit [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

Fox and Marla Sokoloff.

programme.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: From Paris With Love

Annie also needs to help her son, Dillard (John Denver), a country singer struggling to raise his two daughters on his own. As Annie deals with these pressures, she begins to reflect on her long life on the farm.

Held captive in a prisoner-of-war camp at a derelict orphanage, Newby is released after the Italian armistice of 1943. But his freedom is short-lived. Newby soon finds himself the target of a Nazi division that refuses to surrender. He survives thanks to the help of Italian farmers and a woman, Wanda (Barbora Bobulova), who gives him food, teaches him Italian and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Calm at Sunset
programme.desc: A young man leaves college to follow family tradition and become a deep sea fisherman. Stars Michael Moriarty, Kate Nelligan, Peter Facinelli and Gretchen Mol. From the Hallmark Hall of Fame Collection.

programme.title: Pictures of Hollis Woods

Larry's family is uncomfortable at first around Lara, whom Gladwyn treats differently from her biological offspring. Easing the transition along is Thunderwith, a dog who becomes a friend to Lara, helping her forgive and connect to the relative strangers who make up her new family.

The couple focus all their attention and love on their son, Simon (Jordan Brower), and daughter, Clea (Thora Birch). When Simon dies suddenly in a tragic horseback-riding accident, Nora takes the death especially hard and falls into a deep depression. With the help of Nora's mother, Maggie (Ellen Burstyn), Neal attempts to reconnect with his wife and save his family.

programme.desc: A newlywed couple proves their crime-solving prowess when their political ties and successful private-eye business suddenly put them in grave danger. When their parents are taken hostage by a vengeful kidnapper looking for justice for the wrongful murder conviction of his brother, the duo must work together to uncover the clues that will save their parents' lives -- and put their own on the line. Based on the book by Mary Higgins Clark. Stars Jack Wagner, Cameron Mathison andRachel Blanchard.

But when their mother dies, Judy suddenly finds that she is Christine's caretaker. The self-centered Judy is now forced to reevaluate her priorities, while Christine continues her own quest for independence.

With his grandson, John journeys to Los Angeles to find Natalie -- who's now a family court judge with her own reasons for wanting to avoid her father.

Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: The Goode Family
programme.desc: Helen is accused of shoplifting and banned from One Earth, her favorite store.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker

His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night

They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: The Brood
programme.desc: Mad psychopathic therapist (Oliver Reed) treats raging woman (Samantha Eggar).

programme.title: The Imposter
programme.desc: Filmmaker Bart Layton chronicles the tale of Frederic Bourdin, a con artist who seemingly tricked a Texas family into believing he was a relative who disappeared years earlier.

programme.title: The BeastMaster
programme.desc: A psychic (Marc Singer) saves a slave girl (Tanya Roberts) from a sorcerer (Rip Torn).

programme.title: Stagecoach
programme.desc: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.

programme.title: Compromising Positions
programme.desc: The murder of a swinging Long Island dentist puts an ex-reporter housewife (Susan Sarandon) onto a story.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: The Long Good Friday
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, Cockney crime boss Harold Shand (Bob Hoskins), a gangster trying to become a legitimate property mogul, has big plans to get the American Mafia to bankroll his transformation of a derelict area of London into the possible venue for future Olympic Games. However, a series of bombings targets his empire on the very weekend the Americans are in town. Shand is convinced there is a traitor in his organization, and sets out to eliminate the rat in typically ruthless fashion.

programme.title: 10th and Wolf
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: The Infiltrator
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: The Gambler II
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.

programme.title: Fitzcarraldo

Better known as Fitzcarraldo, this foreigner is obsessed with building an opera house in his town and decides that to make his dream a reality he needs to make a killing in the rubber business. In order to become a successful rubber baron, Fitzcarraldo hatches an elaborate plan that calls for a particularly impressive feat -- bringing a massive boat over a mountain with the help of a band of natives.

programme.title: Brain on Fire

As weeks progress and Susannah quickly moves deeper into insanity, her behaviors shift from violence to catatonia. After a series of tantrums, misdiagnoses, and a lengthy hospital stay, a doctor's last-minute intervention enables him to give her a diagnosis and a chance to rebuild her life.

programme.title: Luv
programme.desc: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: In the years before World War II, zany heiress Amanda Kelly (Cybill Shepherd) travels by train to Switzerland. While passing through Germany, she meets a sweet elderly lady, Miss Froy (Angela Lansbury), who suddenly vanishes. Distraught, Amanda questions her fellow passengers who claim that the woman was never there. Unsure if it's all in her mind or if there's a more sinister plot afoot, Amanda teams up with photographer Robert Condon (Elliott Gould) to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part II: The Metal Years
programme.desc: In this follow-up to the 1981 punk rock documentary "The Decline of Western Civilization," filmmaker Penelope Spheeris dissects the world of heavy metal. Through live performance footage and interviews that feature popular hard rock musicians, Spheeris examines the metal genre and the opulent Los Angeles music scene of the late 1980s; highlights include Ozzy Osbourne discussing the tedium of sobriety over breakfast and Aerosmith's Steven Tyler claiming to have spent a small fortune on drugs.

programme.title: Sharkansas Women's Prison Massacre
programme.desc: Five escaped prisoners (Dominique Swain, Cindy Lucas) use their guns and wits to battle prehistoric sharks that attack on land.

programme.title: The Rising Hawk
programme.desc: During the 13th century, a small village fights for freedom in the frontier landscape of the Carpathian Mountains against Mongolian invaders.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: In late-1970s suburban London, Chris (Christian Bale) and Marion (Emily Watson) have settled into a comfortable yet all-too-predictable middle-class existence. Chris receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited friend Toni (Lee Ross), a reunion that reminds him of a more carefree time in the 1960s Paris. Now, with lingering doubts about his marriage bubbling up, Chris must make the choice between revisiting his youthful abandon with Toni or facing the here and now with Marion.

programme.title: Quadrophenia
programme.desc: An angst-ridden London youth, Jimmy Cooper (Phil Daniels) escapes the drudgery of his postal job as a member of the Mods, a sharply dressed gang constantly at odds with their rivals, the Rockers. When the Mods and Rockers clash in the coastal town of Brighton, England, it leads to both trouble and an encounter with the lovely Steph (Leslie Ash). Returning to London, Jimmy, who aspires to be like Mod leader Ace Face (Sting), becomes even more disillusioned and longs to return to Brighton.

programme.title: Last Straw
programme.desc: Masked assailants converge on a roadside diner where a young waitress is working the night shift alone. Trapped inside with no place to go, she soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival as she tries to make it out alive.

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
programme.desc: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black
programme.desc: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

programme.title: C.H.U.D.
programme.desc: Photographer George Cooper (John Heard) is documenting the lives of subterranean homeless people, a population that has mysteriously dwindled. After receiving information from a reporter, George becomes aware of a conspiracy theory about cannibalistic monsters lurking in the sewers. He teams up with the reporter, a policeman (Christopher Curry) and a priest (Daniel Stern) to fight two battles: one against the cannibals and the other against a corrupt government official.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

A mysterious client hires him for a possession case, drawing Dr. Cheon into a series of unexplainable events that challenge his beliefs and revives childhood horrors he's tried to forget.

Along the way, Guile recruits Chun-Li (Ming-Na Wen), a reporter and martial-arts expert whose father was killed by Bison years ago, two young con men (Damian Chapa, Byron Mann) and a sumo wrestler (Peter Navy Tuiasosopo).

programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Crime boss Bart raises orphan Danny with no knowledge of anything other than how to fight, using him as an enforcer when debts must be collected. Planning to enter Danny into a fight tournament and retire with the prize money, Bart disappears after a deadly drive-by shooting. Danny flees and takes shelter with piano tuner Sam. Away from Bart's abusive control, Danny learns how to live like a human and begins investigating his past.

programme.title: The Shadow
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s New York, a reformed criminal becomes a superhero. With the aid of a beautiful female friend, a playboy millionaire with a dark past sets out to bring the evil Shiwan Khan to justice. His quarry, who is determined to attain world domination, is a deadly descendant of Genghis Khan and will not surrender without a fight.

programme.title: Mobsters
programme.desc: Loosely based on real historical figures, this drama focuses on the empire built by enterprising young criminals Lucky Luciano (Christian Slater) and Meyer Lansky (Patrick Dempsey). Along with Bugsy Siegel (Richard Grieco) and Frank Costello (Costas Mandylor), Luciano and Lansky establish a revitalized mob in New York City, effectively displacing their predecessors. Despite the gangsters' humble beginnings on the streets, they eventually rise to control much of the city.

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: Ex-con Max Truemont (Josh Holloway) is desperate for money so he can start a new life with his fiancée (Sarah Wayne Callies). When he is unable to secure the funds by ordinary means, he takes part in a plan to kidnap the young son of one of the state's wealthiest women. While awaiting instructions at their remote hideout, the kidnappers begin to turn on each other, and Max realizes that the boy may have a supernatural hand in the horrific events that follow.

programme.title: Mortal Engines
programme.desc: Hundreds of years after a cataclysmic event destroyed civilization, mysterious young Hester Shaw emerges as the only one who can stop the city of London -- now a giant predator on wheels -- from devouring everything in its path.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: Young Bruce Lee is trying to make a name for himself while working as a martial arts instructor in 1964 San Francisco. When Lee meets Wong Jack Man, he challenges the kung fu master to a no-holds-barred fight that became the stuff of legend.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: When a mercenary warrior (Matt Damon) is imprisoned within the Great Wall, he discovers the mystery behind one of the greatest wonders of the world. As wave after wave of marauding beasts besiege the massive structure, his quest for fortune turns into a journey toward heroism as he joins a huge army of elite warriors to confront the unimaginable and seemingly unstoppable force.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Unleashed

Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: Glass
programme.desc: David Dunn tries to stay one step ahead of the law while delivering vigilante justice on the streets of Philadelphia. His special talents soon put him on a collision course with the Beast -- the psychotic madman who has superhuman strength and 23 distinct personalities. Their epic showdown leads them to an encounter with the mysterious Elijah Price, the criminal mastermind who holds critical secrets for both men.

In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: A civilian truck driver in Iraq, Paul Conroy (Ryan Reynolds) falls victim to a band of insurgents. An unknown length of time later, Paul awakes in a coffin, with little more than a lighter, a cell phone, and his ever-growing anxiety. Faced with a dwindling oxygen supply and a dying battery, Paul must fight panic, despair and delirium as he awaits a rescue that might not arrive in time.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. However, after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now, their expert climbing skills are put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

programme.title: Escape the Field
programme.desc: Stripped of their possessions, six strangers wake up in a remote, endless cornfield with six items -- a gun with a single bullet, matches, a lantern, a knife, a compass and a flask of water. As mysterious sirens blare in the distance and traps appear at every turn, they soon realize they're in a mysterious cat-and-mouse game with an unseen evil, and survival depends upon solving a diabolical and deadly puzzle.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Without remembering how they got there, several strangers awaken in a prison of cubic cells, some of them booby-trapped. There's onetime cop Quentin (Maurice Dean Wint), scientist Holloway (Nicky Guadagni), young math genius Leaven (Nicole de Boer), master of escapes Rennes (Wayne Robson), autistic savant Kazan (Andrew Miller) and architect Worth (David Hewlett), who might have more information on the maze than he lets on. The prisoners must use their combined skills if they are to escape.

programme.title: Beyond the Reach
programme.desc: In the Mojave Desert, a naked and unarmed hunting guide (Jeremy Irvine) runs from a wealthy hunter (Michael Douglas) who wants to ensure his silence in the death of an old man.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

programme.title: No Escape
programme.desc: American businessman Jack Dwyer, wife Annie and their two young daughters arrive in Southeast Asia to begin a new life. As his company plans to improve the region's water quality, the family quickly learns that they're right in the middle of a political uprising. Armed rebels attack the hotel where they're staying, ordered to kill any foreigners that they encounter. Amid the chaos, Jack must find a way to save himself and his loved ones from the violence erupting all around them.

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats continue to suffer from blazing heat and a perilous food crisis! As the seas finally calm, fishing is their only hope! Meanwhile, Sanji arrives in Big Mom's territory and keeps his cool - until he sees his bride-to-be!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is in danger as the venomous fish poison courses through his body! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a mysterious ship for help - a ship that bears a truly surprising crew!

programme.desc: On the edge of life and death, Luffy's only hope rests with Sanji's siblings! But even though they refuse to share an antidote, they may be able to save Luffy's life yet, giving him enough energy to plunge right back into trouble.
programme.sub-title: A Deadly Poison Crisis! Luffy and Reiju!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats confront Pudding - the fiancée of Sanji! But when they challenge her for Sanji's heart, her answer shocks them! Meanwhile, an ominous and mysterious message may spell doom for the Straw Hats.
programme.sub-title: The Emperor's Daughter! Sanji's fiancée - Pudding!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The dangerous waters around the Whole Cake Island harbor terrifying creatures that pose a challenge for the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Mama slips into a bout of her sickness and ravages her own land in search of a specific pastry!
programme.sub-title: A Massive Attack! Mom's Hunger Pangs!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Big Mom rampages through the Whole Cake Island in search for sweets - but when the kitchen can't prepare them fast enough, her own son steps in to curb the carnage, with deadly results.
programme.sub-title: The Capital City Falls?! Big Mom and Jimbei!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the Straw Hats draw closer to the Whole Cake Island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom's territory - and hatches a plan to win back Sanji and take an item of great worth from the Emperor!
programme.sub-title: The Emperor's Castle! Arriving at the Whole Cake Island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook and Pedro head out in a submersible to infiltrate Big Mom's stronghold! Meanwhile, Luffy, Nami, Chopper and Carrot head into the island chasing the image of Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy!
programme.sub-title: A Mysterious Forest Full of Candies! Luffy vs. Luffy?!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Lost in the bewildering woods and chasing after Sanji, Nami and the others find there's more than meets the eye in this upside down part of the Whole Cake Island! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his brother!
programme.sub-title: Mom's Assassin! Luffy and the Seducing Woods!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy continues to move through the mysterious and dangerous woods, unaware of the danger that lurks in the trees! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his father as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare!
programme.sub-title: A Seafaring Kingdom! Germa's King Judge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji faces off against his father in a duel! His powerful kicks aim at protecting his hands, but the Germa Family has more in store for him yet! Meanwhile, Luffy goes deeper into the Seducing Woods and falls for their powerful illusions!
programme.sub-title: A Battle Between Father and Son! Judge vs. Sanji!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Big Mom has Caesar Clown at her whims - and despite his bilking her out of countless amounts of money - she is ready to continue her pursuit of maniacal world control!
programme.sub-title: A Giant Ambition! Big Mom and Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Finally, Nami finds Luffy and recounts her harrowing tale of battling Brulee! Meanwhile, the mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his true identity! But this must all be put aside when one of Mom's most powerful generals comes calling!
programme.sub-title: The Land of Souls! Mom's Fatal Ability!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The identity of the enigmatic Pound, the man half-buried in the woods, is revealed, but his deep connection to Big Mom might not be enough to save him! Nami's past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping Mom's minions at bay!
programme.sub-title: A Top Officer! The Sweet 3 General Cracker Appears!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy squares off against Cracker, one of the Sweet 3 Generals, as Nami learns the truth about others in the Worst Generation who have come before to challenge Big Mom!
programme.sub-title: An Enemy Worth 800 million! Luffy vs. Thousand Armed Cracker!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy continues to fight against Cracker, whose powers to manipulate his surroundings may prove more troublesome than he had thought! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate the Whole Cake Island - and must hatch a plan to avoid getting caught!
programme.sub-title: An All-out Duel! Gear Four vs. the Bis-Bis Ability

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy starts to run out of steam as the Biscuit Warriors keep multiplying! If he can buy himself 10 minutes to recharge…

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: The Past that He Let Go of! Vinsmoke Sanji!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The terrible history of Sanji's family continue to unfold. From a rare moment of compassion, he is able to escape, only to face his father's cruelty before setting out on his own.
programme.sub-title: To the East Blue! Sanji's Resolute Departure!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is in an all-out, all-you-can-eat battle! As Cracker's endless stream of Biscuit Warriors marches on, Luffy's endless appetite is put to the test. Meanwhile, Reiju helps Sanji to straighten himself out before he meets his fiancée.
programme.sub-title: A Battle of Limits! Luffy and the Infinite Biscuits!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy needs to think fast in order to turn the battle in his favor - filled with biscuits, he debuts a new Gear Four attack that has lasting repercussions! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot find Sanji's reflection, but can they get a message to him in time?

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Quentin Tarantino
programme.desc: After years of failed attempts, Quentin Tarantino finally cracks his long-gestating World War II film that would become Inglourious Basterds.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: The push for action leaves the team scrambling to come up with new ways of doing things. But just when the team is ready to kick off the superhero genre, a tragedy derails their plans.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Despite his success, Sam Raimi loses his creative freedom as Marvel and Sony’s tug of war begins to affect the story. Spider-man 3 conquers the box office but loses the fans, as Sam decides whether to carry on or walk away.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Sony reboots the franchise with a new director and a new Spider-man, but can this new version compete with the rise of the MCU? When hackers attack Sony, their plans for the webslinger come undone and an unprecedented deal is struck.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Spider-man comes home to Marvel, but can Marvel and Sony get along enough to keep him there? The franchise comes full circle, bringing everyone back together in a time of crisis.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: With the clock ticking Peter Jackson has to find a studio to save his work in progress. Only one studio is willing to take the gamble on three films made at once adapting an unwanted property led by an unproven director on the other side of the world.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
programme.desc: The studio that backed the films takes a gamble too far. Peter Jackson struggles in vain to avoid the burden of directing. In the midst of a grueling shoot one of the dwarves is sent packing.

programme.title: Icons Unearthed: The Lord of the Rings
